data.name: BluSky Carbon
data.description: BluSky Carbon Inc. (CSE: BSKY / OTCQB: BSKCF) is a Vancouver, BC–based publicly-listed carbon removal company that converts organic waste into biochar using its Vulcan Heavy pyrolysis systems. Its flagship AR1 facility in Warren, Arkansas began production in late 2024 to service a US$105M, 10-year, 382,213-tonne biochar offtake agreement, and the company announced a Carbonpave partnership in September 2025 to co-develop biochar-based asphalt at AR1.
